review: Narrow truth and wording recheck of MEM-S2-01
checked_text: This function describes how the readout variance decreases toward its limit as observation continues.
evidence: The sentence now refers to full ideal readout variance V(L)=sqrt(2D/J)coth(sqrt(2DJ)L). For positive D,J,L it decreases monotonically toward sqrt(2D/J). It no longer calls the positive limiting variance 'extra error'. Wording is short and names the intended quantity. The nearby positive-parameter restrictions remain.
